title: CDAD guard recovery event (003-003 guard-event-v1)
description: Durable recovery event persisted by `cdad_guard record` under `.cdad/executions/<execution_id>/guards/**` (D4) and keyed by execution_id+packet_id+attempt. It is emitted verbatim inside the `record-v1` envelope; the orchestrator owns the semantic decision (D1/D5).

action.description: Recovery action recorded for the attempt, from the closed event->action table (D5). The same table constrains the escalation channel emitted by `classify`.
